tay: Heads-up: adding a small "Region-aware provisioning" section to Dedicated Provisioning. Need a Go SDK snippet + a short rollforward playbook (not full rollback). cc @riley @marco for accuracy.

riley: SGTM. show pool selection rules: prefer same-region reserved pools, fall back to cross-region with data-residency note. call out SLA checkpoints (post-provision warmup) and scale-in cooldown to avoid oscillation.

tay: planned sequence (will paste as inline steps): User request -> quota check (409 on fail) -> pool selector (region preference) -> attach autoscale (min,max,cooldown,scale_in_grace) -> canary 10% -> SLA checks (p95, error rate) -> if pass promote, if fail rollforward to alt pool or revert traffic.

marco: tiny nit: we prefer "rollforward" when trying alternate pool/model before full rollback. include example cooldowns and p95 thresholds.

yvonne: add eviction note: eviction_grace_period, eviction_priority_label, and isolation_label decorator. link to eng-sre runbook for preemption thresholds.

Go SDK snippet (short):
package main

import (
  "fmt"
  "github.com/redwood/redwood-go"
)

func main() {
  client := redwood.NewDedicatedClient("$REDWOOD_KEY")
  req := redwood.ProvisionRequest{
    TenantID: "tenant_xyz",
    Model:    "gpt-large-quant",
    RegionAffinity: "eu-central-1",
    ReservedPool:   "eu-central-1-reserved-a",
    Autoscale: redwood.AutoscaleConfig{MinReplicas:1, MaxReplicas:8, CooldownSeconds:120, ScaleInGraceSeconds:300},
  }
  prov, err := client.Provisionings.Create(req)
  if err != nil {
    panic(err)
  }
  fmt.Println("provision id:", prov.ID)
}

YAML autoscale example:
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 1
  max_replicas: 8
  cooldown_seconds: 120
  scale_in_grace_seconds: 300
  policy: cpu

riley: include default thresholds in prose: p95 < 250ms, error_rate < 0.5% during 5-10m canary; customers may override.

Suggested rollforward checklist (pasteable bullets):
- confirm failing metric (p95, errors)
- attempt rollforward: `redwood-cli provision rollforward --provision-id <id> --target-pool <pool>`
- if rollforward fails, revert traffic: `redwood-cli routing set --provision-id <id> --target-version <previous>`
- reassign tenant (SDK): `client.Provisionings.Update(tenantID, ProvisionUpdate{ReservedPool: "previous_pool"})`
- run smoke tests and monitor p95/error for 10m
- escalate to eng-sre if capacity exhausted with logs + commit id + infra events

yvonne: add pool drain command example: `redwood-cli pool set-state --pool <pool> --state drain` and mention draining respects eviction_grace_period.
